name: carpool-platform
description: RideSync — organization-based carpool management platform (admin, employee web, public site, mobile)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web,admin,employee -c yellow,gray,cyan,green "npm:dev -w backend" "npm:dev -w web" "npm:dev -w admin" "npm:dev -w employee-web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w admin && npm run typecheck -w employee-web && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w employee-web
